qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialized RF and fiber connectivity engineering know-how, but faces intense competition from global interconnect peers (Amphenol, TE Connectivity). Cyclical demand from telecom carriers and industrial OEMs limits pricing power, keeping multi-year GAAP ROIC below the 12% hurdle (~10-11%) with operating margins around 9-11%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Swiss connectivity and optical component specialist with cyclical telecom and industrial exposure. Multi-year GAAP ROIC averages ~10-11% (below 12% threshold), and operating margins fluctuate around 9-11% without structural pricing power over global telecom and transport OEMs.
qualitative.evidence: EBIT dropped 25% in FY2023 (CHF 77.6M vs 103.2M in 2022) with operating margins falling to 9.1% due to telecom capex curtailments. Multi-year GAAP ROIC (NOPAT / Total Capital) tracks ~10.4-11.0% across 2020-2024, failing the 12% threshold. High exposure to cyclical 5G infrastructure capex and competition from larger peers.
